source.title: Revenue eBrief No. 168/25 — Part 38-01-03b: Guidelines for VAT Registration updated
source.note: A Revenue notice: it records that TDM Part 38-01-03b was updated on 3 September 2025 (sections 3.4, 3.4.4 and 10). It ranks below legislation (sourceHierarchy.ts) and never supersedes the Act or the Regulations; it tells a reader the guidance this KB cites has moved.

provisions.heading: Part 38-01-03b - Guidelines for VAT Registration
provisions.relevanceReason: Curated: a procedure rule cites this notice (ebriefIngestion.ts).
provisions.excerpt: Revenue eBrief No. 168/25 03 September 2025 Part 38-01-03b - Guidelines for VAT Registration Tax and Duty Manual Part 38-01-03b - Guidelines for VAT Registration - has been updated as follows: Section 3.4 - VAT registration application details Section 3.4.4 - Turnover and registration thresholds Section 10 - EU VAT SME scheme Published: 03 September 2025
